Commentary.Commentary: Niroshan Dickwella ended up being the lone warrior for Sri Lanka, turning out unscathed with an unbeaten 40-run knock. Sadly, he failed to find much support from the other end. Kaushal Silva was the next best scorer for them in this innings, but nothing much from the others. Their skipper fell victim to a Yasir Shah beauty and from thereon it was all downhill till the keeper played a vital knock. Now it's over to their bowlers to defend what they have got. Will we see Pakistan chase this target down, or does this game have yet another twist in it? Do join us after the lunch break for the second session.

Pakistan need 136 to go one up in the series! All the planning in their camp would have been about this - bowling out the opposition quickly. They have done so. Yasir Shah was the wrecker-in-chief as he picked up yet another fifer. The Lankans couldn't repeat their batting performance of their first innings, the track playing a major part in that. The regular fall of wickets meant that Sri Lanka couldn't put up a score that they would have liked. It was a collective bowling effort from the hosts that has helped them restrict the opposition to a score they believe they can achieve.

OUT! Knocked him over! That is too good a delivery for a number 11! Ali steams in a spears in a fuller delivery around off. Pradeep pushes at that and the ball sneaks in through the gap between bat and pad and disturbs the timber behind. The signature Hasan Ali celebration follows! SRI LANKA ALL OUT FOR 138!
This is hurled on a length outside off, Dickwella plays it towards point and runs across for a run.
Fuller ball around off, Niroshan defends it off the front foot.
This delivery is flicked away to mid-wicket.
Short delivery around middle and leg, Dickwella pulls it, gets it off the top edge past the keeper for a brace.
NUWAN PRADEEP is the last man in.

OUT! Would you believe it, Sandakan has thrown it away in what would have been the last ball of the session! 12th five-fer for Yasir Shah! He bowls a wrong 'un, a tad short outside off, Sandakan stays back and cuts it aerially, straight to Amir at backward point. He should be gutted, as he's just thrown it away. The Lankans lead by 132. The lunch has been extended owing to this wicket.
Shah comes back over the wicket and lands it around off, Sandakan bunts it off the front foot.
Floats it on the pads, flicked away to mid-wicket.
Tossed up ball around middle, defended off the front foot.
This delivery in line of the stumps is played off the back foot.
Comes round the wicket and serves a loopy delivery around leg, Sandakan pads it away.
This ball is cut straight to the point fielder.
Another cover-drive, but this time finds the fielder.
Fuller ball outside off, driven through covers for a brace.
Dickwella defends this off the back foot.

Shafiq puts down another one! Ali bowls it fuller outside off, Dickwella looks to guide it away to third man. Ends up getting a thick outside edge to the lone wide slip Asad Shafiq, who grasses yet another chance. This is not helping things for Pakistan, who are on the lookout for quick wickets.
Full delivery outside off, Dickwella drives it through point. The fielder in the deep rushes to his right, puts in the slide and keeps the batsmen down to two.

Well bowled and even better kept! Yasir comes round the wicket and bowls it flatter around middle. Sandakan looks to defend but misses the ball. Ahmed crouches low to collect that. The ball just shoots after pitching!
Shortish ball around off, Sandakan goes back and slaps it through cover-point for a brace.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
This ball is blocked off the back foot from within the crease.
Floated around off, Lakshan strides forward to defend that.
Tossed up delivery in line of the stumps, Sandakan defends it off the front foot.
Length delivery around off, Niroshan gets squared up and gets a leading edge towards covers. He wanted a run initially but decides against it.
On a length outside off, Dickwella looks to push at it but gets beaten.
Now Ali comes round the wicket and hurls it around the off stump. Niroshan stands tall and defends.

FOUR! Edgy runs, but Sri Lanka won't mind that! Length delivery around off, Dickwella looks to clip it away. But the ball catches the outside edge of the bat and flies through the gap between the first slip and gully for a boundary.
Beautifully driven! Full ball around off, Dickwella plays it through covers for a brace.
Good start! Ali hurls it outside off, Dickwella looks to drive but misses.
HASAN ALI to have a bowl now. Remember he had walked back yesterday owing to an issue with his back.
Another ball around off is reverse swept away for a run.
Yasir tosses it up around off, Dickwella charges down and pads it away.
Loopy ball around off, defended off the front foot onto the ground.
That ball has struck the batsman on the thigh-pad.
That's a grubber! Yasir serves it outside off, Dickwella goes back to defend but the ball just doesn't rise. The keeper misses the ball but the batsmen don't steal a bye.
FOUR! And finally the shot produces him a boundary! Tossed up delivery around off, Dickwella reverse sweeps that over point for a boundary.

Amir bowls it in line of the stumps, Dickwella taps it in front of square on the leg side and rushes for a quick run. The fielder there has a shy at the non-striker's end but misses. Niroshan was safe through.
Full in line of the stumps, Dickwella backs away but hits it straight to the cover fielder.
FOUR! Brilliant, clever and effective! Amir bangs it short around middle, Dickwella sways back and plays the ramp shot over the keeper's head for a boundary.
A tad fuller outside off, Niroshan drives towards deep covers. Sandakan wanted a run but there was a loud 'no' from Dickwella the moment he played that.
The batsman was beaten and missed the line of the delivery.
Length ball in line of the stumps, pushed towards covers from the crease.
Nervy! A tad shorter around off, Sandakan looks to pull it away. Ends up getting an inside edge that strikes him on the inside of the front leg and lands next to the stumps.
Tossed up delivery around off, Dickwella charges down and clips it through mid-wicket.
Dickwella defends this delivery from the crease, showing the full face of the bat.
Floated outside off, Dickwella offers no stroke and wears it on the pads.

Loopy ball around middle and leg, he goes back to clip it away. The ball lobs off his thigh pad and flies over the leaping short leg fielder. There were shouts of 'catch it' but there was no edge there.
Shah floats it outside off, Dickwella gets down and reverse sweeps it through the front of square on the off side. Good running gets him a couple.

FOUR! The plan almost worked! Keeping a leg slip in place, Amir bowls it full in line of the leg stump. Sandakan, being the tailender that he is, flicks it aerially, past Azam at leg slip. The ball raced away to the fence.
That's well played! Amir hurls it on a length outside off, Dickwella shuffles across and clips it through square leg for a run.
This is again outside off, ND fails to get bat onto that and misses the ball.
Length delivery outside off, Dickwella plays inside the line and lets that go.
This is on a length outside off, Niroshan plays it towards point.
Wonderfully bowled! Amir spears in a yorker around off and middle, Dickwella does extremely well to dig that out.
This is a tad short around off, punched towards long on for a run.
This is bowled outside off, Dickwella looks to play at that but misses.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Tossed up delivery outside off, Dickwella pads it away.
Shah loops it up around middle, Niroshan looks to sweep. But the ball lobs off his thigh pad to short leg. The players appeal but to no avail.
Loopy ball around off, Dickwella defends it from the crease.
Mid on and mid-wicket are in the deep.
Fuller ball around off. Sandakan defends it off the front foot.
This delivery is driven superbly through covers for a brace.
This is a short ball down the leg side, Lakshan misses the flick.
Length delivery just outside off, Sandakan looks to push at it but gets beaten.
This is around off and middle, flicked away through mid-wicket for a run.
On a length around off, Dickwella defends it from within the crease.
Keeps out the hat-trick! Shah bowls it around off, Sandakan defends it off the front foot.
Umbrella field in place. Will Sandakan survive this?
LAKSHAN SANDAKAN is the next man in. He will face the hat-trick ball.

OUT! Two-in-two for Yasir Shah! He loops it up around off, Herath lunges forward to defend. But the ball spins back in, catches the inside edge, lobs up after hitting the pad and Masood at short leg does extremely well to pull off a diving catch. Excellently done. Herath goes for a duck, the lead is still 98!

OUT! Perera is a goner! The drop doesn't prove to be costly. Yasir Shah serves a quicker one in line of the stumps, Dilruwan looks to defend but misses the ball and gets hit on the pads. The umpire immediately raises the dreaded finger on appeal by the Pakistan players. For some strange reason, Perera chooses to review it immediately. Replays ruled out presence of an inside edge, although multiple looks revealed that. Hawk Eye confirms that he was hit adjacent to the stumps. So Sri Lanka are sliding further, with the lead 98! Rangana Herath will walk in next.
Perera has been ruled out LBW. But he immediately chooses to review that. Maybe he feels he has got some bat onto that.
Floated in line of the stumps, Perera defends it off the front foot.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

Just away from short leg! Shah tosses it around off, Dickwella gets down to sweep. The ball hits the top edge, deflects off his helmet and rolls past the right of Masood at short leg. Again the fielder moved to his left and hence misses the ball completely. One run taken.
Full and down the leg side, Dilruwan looks to flick but misses.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Bowls it outside off, Perera lets it be.

Dropped! Asad Shafiq the culprit! Peach of a delivery. Amir bowls it on a length around middle and off, Perera just had to play at that and he does. The ball bounces a tad more and takes the edge of the bat and flies towards the slip cordon. Shafiq dives to his left from second slip but fails to latch on to that. In hindsight, it could have been an easier catch for the first slip fielder, Azam. Interesting to note is the absence of Azhar Ali from the slip cordon. Normally he's the guy standing there! Perera gets a life!
Close! Hurls it fuller outside off, inviting the drive. Perera looks to play at that with minimal feet movement and gets beaten.
Amir runs in and spears it full on the pads, Perera clips it to mid-wicket.

Drinks have been taken! It has been a good first hour of play. Pakistan managed to snap up both the overnight batsmen. But so far Dickwella and Perera have looked good and assured both against pace and spin. The lead is 97 and Sri Lanka would look to swell the lead. Pakistan would strive hard to prevent that.
Another delivery around off is swept away to short fine leg.

FOUR! Brilliantly played. This shot proves how good Dickwella is against spinners. Yasir Shah loops it up around off, Niroshan charges down and smashes it down the ground. The ball wastes no time in racing away to the fence. 100 up for Sri Lanka with that!
Flatter in line of the stumps, clipped to mid-wicket.
This delivery is swept straight to the short fine leg fielder.
Loopy delivery around off, Dickwella charges down and blocks it.
A long hop around off, Perera goes deep in the crease and pulls it through mid-wicket. The fielder from mid on chases that down but the batsmen take three. Excellent running there.
Length delivery around off, Dickwella defends it from within the crease.
Amir bowls it full outside off, Dickwella drives it towards the cover fielder.
Steams in and spears it fuller outside off, Dickwella plays inside the line to let the ball pass.
This is bowled fuller outside off, Niroshan drives it to the mid off fielder.
Similar delivery outside off, Dickwella punches it towards covers.
Starts off with a length ball around off, Dickwella defends it from the crease.
MOHAMMAD AMIR is brought in to bowl.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Beaten all ends up! Tossed up delivery around off, Perera strides forward to defend but the ball passes the edge of the bat.
This is played off the front foot to silly point.
Floats it around off and middle, Dickwella gets it off the pads for a leg bye.
Yasir tosses it very wide of off, Dickwella guides it to backward point.
Quicker straighter delivery around middle and leg, Dilruwan looks to defend but gets it off the inner half of the bat, past short leg for a run.
Bowled a tad short around off, pulled straight to square leg.
Length ball around off, pushed towards mid on.
This is bowled around off, Niroshan defends off the front foot.
Very full inswinging delivery, almost a yorker. Perera watches it well and digs it out towards mid on for a run.
Spears it outside off, Perera shoulders his arms in response.
On a length outside off, Perera doesn't bother to play at that and lets it be.
Loopy delivery around middle, flicked towards mid-wicket.
Floats it outside off, Dickwella reverse sweeps it. Gets it off the top edge of the bat as the ball rolls towards third man. Two runs taken.
Lucky! This is a leg-spinner in line of the stumps that didn't turn, Perera didn't seem to have picked that. Gets an inside edge as he is hurried onto that. The ball rolls towards fine leg for a run.
Perera looks to cut that but misses the ball completely.
Connects the sweep this time. Yasir serves it around middle and leg, Dickwella plays it through square leg for a run.
Tosses this around middle and leg, Dickwella looks to flick but misses and wears it on the pads.
This delivery outside is left alone. The ball barely carried to the keeper.
Full delivery around off, Perera looks to drive but gets beaten on the inside.
DILRUWAN PERERA walks in to bat at the fall of the sixth wicket. He's got runs with the bat in recent times and the Lankans would hope for an encore!

OUT! The nightwatchman falls to a short ball! Mohammad Abbas bangs it short around off, Lakmal is unable to resist the temptation to pull. He goes through with the shot but Pakistan were prepared for this and had a man in the deep. Babar Azam at deep square leg catches it ever so easily to hand Abbas another wicket. Lakmal was never comfortable with the short ball today and in the end falls prey to it. Interestingly, he seemed to have hit that well. Sri Lanka are threatening to fold up rather early here. They lead by only 83!
This is hurled outside off, Suranga leaves it alone.

FOUR! Streaky yet effective! Abbas hurls it full outside off, Lakmal throws his bat in a bid to drive that. Gets a thick outside edge that rolls through the slip cordon for a boundary. This would frustrate Pakistan to no end.
Abbas comes round the wicket and bangs it short around off. Dickwella pulls it through square leg for a run.
Beauty! Shah gives some more air to this delivery outside off. Lakmal looks to defend off the front foot but sees the ball whiz past the edge of the bat.
Tossed up delivery around off, Lakmal lunges forward and defends it.
Quicker down the leg side, Lakmal looks to flick but misses.
Loopy ball outside off, Lakmal lets it be.
This delivery in line of the stumps is defended from the crease.
Flatter on the pads, worked away towards mid-wicket for a run.
Lakmal is down on the ground. He looks to be in some pain and the physio is tending to him. Sri Lanka would not want to lose him as he would be vital for their chances with the ball later in the day.
Another bouncer outside off, left alone.
Slower off-cutter around off, Lakmal defends it off the front foot. Seems to have read the pace of the ball there.
On a length around off, Suranga shows full face of the bat while defending that.
This delivery is pushed towards mid on.
Bouncer outside off, Lakmal looks to pull but misses.
On a length outside off, Lakmal goes for the pull but gets the bottom edge next to the pitch.
Another failed sweep in this over! Yasir serves it around middle and spinning down leg. Niroshan plays and misses yet again.
Dickwella again looks to sweep and wears it on the thigh pad. He'd rather fancy the reverse sweep as this could bring his downfall.
Lands it around off, Niroshan looks to play from the crease. Gets it off his forearm to first slip. A stifled appeal follows, only to be turned down.

And again! Shah floats it around off, Dickwella goes for the sweep again. The ball hits his helmet and lands near the short leg fielder. Interestingly, the Shan Masood there looks to take evasive action anticipating the shot and loses his balance in the process! That looked funny!
Floats it around off, Niroshan blocks off the back foot.
Tosses this outside off, the ball spins in sharply. Dickwella looks to sweep but misses.
Dickwella gets going straightaway! Length ball on the pads, flicked through mid-wicket for a run.
This is flicked away through mid-wicket for a run.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the backfoot.

FOUR! Now that would give him some confidence! On a back of a length around off, Lakmal stays in the crease and pulls it through backward square leg. The ball races away to the fence for the first boundary of the day.
Length ball outside off, it nips back in a great deal again. Hits Lakmal high on the pads. The players appeal but the umpire stays put.
Landed around off, Lakmal blocks it from the crease.
Quicker on the pads, he misses to put bat to that and wears it on the pads. They steal a leg bye.
Another ball around off, it is blocked off the front foot.
Lands it in line of the stumps, Suranga blocks it off the front foot.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
This is flatter around leg, Lakmal misses the flick and wears it on his pads.
Tosses it outside off, Lakmal pushes it towards covers.
NIROSHAN DICKWELLA is the next man in. How will he approach this now? Meanwhile, umpire Richard Kettleborough is seen giving some friendly advise to Sarfraz Ahmed regarding excessive appealing.

OUT! Mendis has to depart! Abbas' clever bowling has earned him a wicket. He lands it on a length outside off, Mendis looks to push at it, but the massive inward movement of the ball meant that he misses it and the ball strikes him on the pads. A long appeal follows, which is upheld. After some thought, Mendis goes upstairs. Hawk Eye shows that it is umpire's call on impact and the ball would go on to hit the off stump. Sri Lanka lose the wicket although they retain the review. Big wicket this for Pakistan.
Given! Mendis has been adjudged LBW. After a lonnng thought, he decides to review that. Seems mighty close.
Beaten! That's bowled on a length outside off, Mendis looks to push at that but the ball moves away just a tad to beat the edge of the bat. Beautifully bowled.
Aerial but safe! That was banged short around off and middle, Lakmal gets into a tangle as he looks to pull that. Gets a top edge that lands at where short fine leg would have been. One run taken.
Spears it outside off, Lakmal shoulders arms to let that go.
Two slips in place now.
This is bowled around off, Lakmal stays on the back foot and plays towards point. The ball moved away just that little bit after pitching.
Bowls it full outside off, Lakmal strides forward and points his bat skywards to leave it alone.
Floated around middle and leg, Mendis bunts it down from within the crease.
Flatter in line of the stumps, whipped away in front of square on the leg side for a run. First runs for Lakmal for the day.
Lovely loopy leg break outside off, the ball spins away. Lakmal lets that go without playing at that.
Loopy delivery in line of the stumps, the nightwatchman shows the full face of the bat to defend that.
Tosses it around middle and leg, Suranga lunges forward and defends it off the front foot.
Begins with a flat delivery around middle and leg, Lakmal blocks it from within the crease.
YASIR SHAH to bowl from the other end. Knowing that the track is good for spin bowling, Pakistan would want him to strike early.
Length ball well outside off, Mendis doesn't bother to play at that and lets it go to the keeper.
Hurled fuller around off, Mendis pushes it off the front foot towards point.
Lands it on a length outside off, Kusal shoulders arms and lets that go to the keeper.
A tad fuller around off and middle, Mendis pushes it towards mid on.
First runs for the day! This one is around middle, Mendis flicks it towards mid-wicket. The fielder there makes a half-stop but is unable to prevent the brace.
Runs in and begins with hurling a fuller delivery around off. Mendis strides forward and defends it with the full face of the bat.

The players and the umpires have taken their positions on the field. Everybody is set for another tough session of play. MOHAMMAD ABBAS has the cherry in the hand and will begin the proceedings. KUSAL MENDIS will face him first up. The nightwatchman, SURANGA LAKMAL, is at the other end and he would look to frustrate the opposition by staying out there as long as he can. Pakistan have one slip in place to start with. Here we go...
PITCH REPORT - There are plenty of cracks on the pitch. If anything, the cracks have widened as the game has progressed. It would surely aid spin. Tough times await the batsmen.

Pakistan would be happy with the way the game is poised. What would please them to no end is that their main weapon, Yasir Shah, is proving to be effective as the climax approaches with the track aiding his bowling too. The hosts would love to restrict the opposition to as less as possible for them to have a better chance of going one up. They would do well to remind themselves of the potent spin attack that the visitors possess. Cricket isn't an easy game, leave alone Test cricket. All these ingredients are the makings of a delicious day's play. Stay with us for all the action.

Sri Lanka are effectively 66/4 and would aim to get anything north of 150 for them to defend. The pugnacious Kusal Mendis is at the crease, after surviving some nervy moments before close of play on the fourth day. There's little to follow in batting with only Niroshan Dickwella, the recognized batsman, to follow. Yes, Dilruwan Perera can bat, but on a testing track, it would be a tall ask from him to battle it out for long periods.

The final day, a deteriorating track, spinners in the game, both the sides almost going neck and neck, with one having a slender advantage - this first Test between Pakistan and Sri Lanka has all the makings of a thrilling end. Welcome to the last day's coverage of the game which is being played at the Sheikh Zayed Stadium in Abu Dhabi.
DAY 5, SESSION 1!

You can never rule any team out on a day 5 subcontinent track. If Sri Lanka get to a lead in excess of 150, they have the attack that can turn things around. Will we see Pakistan wrapping things up quickly or do the Islanders have it in them? An exciting end to this Test beckons. Join us at 1000 local (0600 GMT) to catch all the action. Until next time, it's goodbye and cheers!

This match seemed like it would head towards a draw but it proved to be a wrong thought. The Pakistan spinners relished the Day 4 wicket, especially Yasir Shah who exploited the roughs while the rest too got good purchase from the deck which has started to misbehave. Asad Shafiq and Haris Sohail were the other two to have wickets to their name. Sri Lanka, now find themselves in huge trouble as they only lead by 66 runs and have just 6 wickets in hand. The track is expected to deteriorate further tomorrow and so the tourists would be looking to stretch this lead to another hundred odd runs.

Pakistan walk off with their heads held high! They started the day on the back foot as they were trailing by 153 runs with 4 wickets down. A few quick wickets meant that they might surrender to the Lankans. But, it wasn't meant to be as the debutant had other plans. Haris Sohail, the tormentor-in-chief, came out with great intent. Not only did he score a breezy fifty on debut but got good support from Hasan Ali as well, which allowed them to get ahead of the visitors by a mere 3 runs.
Fullish delivery outside off, Lakmal prods forward and defends it with the spin to silly point to see off the day. THAT'S STUMPS ON DAY 4!
Sarfraz calls everyone in. Umbrella field for the last ball of the day...
Straying on the pads, worked through mid-wicket for a couple.

An appeal for a bat-pad denied! Floated around leg stump, Lakmal keeps his bat behind the pad as the ball lobs off something to the silly point fielder. The Pakistanis are interested but the umpire shakes his head. Sarfraz Ahmed walks across to Yasir Shah and has a chat with him about the review. They decide not to take it. Wise call perhaps! Not really. The Snicko shows a bit of spike as the ball goes past the glove. Suranga is a lucky man.
Drifting into Suranga. He keeps it out off the inner half of his bat.
Fraction short this time, Lakmal covers the line to defend it.
Sharne Warne like turn on that one. Quicker one on middle, spinning away venomously. Lakmal has no clue about it as he gets beaten all ends up.
Sarfraz is running towards the other end. He wants one more over from Yasir Shah before stumps...
Fullish delivery, angling in. Mendis comes forward to block it.
In the zone outside off, holding its line. Mendis leaves it alone.
Length delivery around off, pushed off the front foot to covers.
A wide slip comes in place.
Good length delivery in the zone of apprehension. Mendis initially looks to feel for it but bails out at the last moment.
Fuller in length around off, Kusal covers the line and defends it solidly.
On a length outside off, holding its line. Mendis points his bat skywards to allow it through.
Floated around off, defended solidly off the front foot.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Tossed up outside off, eased towards mid off.

Not Out! Shortish outside off, Mendis cuts it towards point and calls for a run. Lakmal is late to take off. Masood dives to his right and throws it towards Ahmed but it is a bit wayward. That allows Suranga to dive and slide his bat in. It is referred upstairs. The replays confirm that Lakmal has made his ground.
A run out appeal against Lakmal is taken upstairs. The batsman has dived to get back in and looks safe...
Quicker delivery, clipped to short leg.
Around off, spinning away. Tapped to covers.
Abbas bowls a pinpoint yorker on middle, Lakmal is alert to it and digs it out.
Silly point in place now.
On a length and angling in sharply. Lakmal looks to defend it off the back foot but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Back of a length delivery on leg stump, Lakmal looks to help it away but the ball raps him on the thigh pad and rolls towards leg gully.
Shaping into Kusal. Turned around the corner for no run.
Length delivery outside off, shaping in. Mendis leaves it alone.
Angling into Mendis. Clipped to mid-wicket.
Mohammad Abbas is brought back into the attack.
Shortish delivery, punched to mid on.
The nightwatchman, Suranga Lakmal comes out to bat. A slip, a leg gully, a short leg in place...

OUT! Shah gets the big fish! The centurion of the first innings departs. Yasir Shah goes a bit wider of the crease and bowls it quick, getting it to drift in towards the leg stump. Chandimal looks to work across the line. Ends up getting an outside edge towards Shafiq at first slip who pouches it comfortably. Yasir is ecstatic and celebrates in a Brett Lee-like manner. It seems like the floodgates have opened. Sri Lanka lead by 62 runs!
Flatter delivery, tucked to mid-wicket.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Tossed up on off, Chandimal turns in the vacant deep mid-wicket region. Amir from square leg hares after it to keep the ball in play. Saves a run for his side.
Full delivery on off, Mendis works it to wide mid on for a run.
Amir loses his radar and slips it down the leg side. Chandimal tries to tuck it away but the ball brushes his thigh pad and carries to the keeper.
Similar length ball outside off, played with an angled blade to point.
Fuller in length well outside off, the Sri Lankan skipper doesn't flirt with it.
Another short delivery, straighter this time. Dinesh again ducks under it.
Well-directed bouncer from Amir around off. Chandimal sits underneath in time.
Back of a length delivery outside off, punched off the back foot to cover-point.
Quick and flat on middle and leg, Kusal does well to block it.
Leans ahead and blocks it with authority.
Continues to be full on off, tapped to covers.
Pitches this one around the leg stump and gets it to spin in. Mendis clears his front leg and keeps it out.
Very full outside off, Mendis whips it to mid on.
Fullish delivery on off, pushed back to the bowler.
Yasir Shah is back on!
In the zone of apprehension, holdings its line. Dinesh doesn't fiddle with it.
Sliding down the leg side, helped around the corner for a single.
Back of a length delivery around the ribs, Chandimal gets into a tangle but manages to tuck it through backward square leg. A run taken.
On a length outside off, Dinesh strides forward to pat it to short cover.
Fractionally overpitched outside off, Chandimal drives it crisply to mid off.
Full length delivery attacking the stumps, played with soft hands back to the bowler.
Amir is back for a burst.
Poor delivery but Kusal fails to capitalize on it! Half-tracker in line of the stumps, Mendis pulls it to the man at mid-wicket. Found out the man to perfection.
Shorter in length, defended solidly off the back foot.
Strides forward and smothers it with the spin.
Mendis decides to uses his feet and Sohail spots him. Smartly fires it on a full length on middle. Dug out to covers.
Flatter one on middle and leg, Mendis brings his bat down at an angle and blocks it.
Coming in with the arm, turned around the corner for a single.
Quicker and straighter one on middle and leg, Mendis works it nicely through in front of square leg. A couple taken.
Short and width on offer, Mendis cuts it through cover-point for a couple. Good batting from Kusal, needs to keep scoring off the loose deliveries.
Around off, tapped to covers.
Fraction short around off, cut to backward point.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Floated in line of the stumps, blocked watchfully.
Allows the ball to come to him and turns it to the leg side.

That's a ripper! Floated on middle, spinning away and stops a bit on the track. Bounces a touch extra as well. Chandimal leans forward to defend but the ball hits the high part of the bat and lobs past the vacant silly point region. It will be tough work for the batsmen.
Fullish on leg stump, Chandimal looks to work it across but gets a soft leading edge down the track.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Around the boots, helped to backward square leg.
Coming in with the arm, blocked solidly.
Flighted full ball, landed around off, Kusal presses forward in defense.
Very full, almost a yorker, Mendis jams it out.
Keeps it really full on off, watchfully defended.
Darts it fuller on off, pushed towards cover for a single.
Short and outside off, cut straight to the point fielder.
Flighted delivery around off, Chandimal dead-bats it.
Comes nicely forward and defends it down.

A shout for an LBW! Sohail tosses it up on middle, Mendis goes back to defend but the ball turns away and pings him on the back pad. They appeal but nothing from the umpire. Maybe, height was an issue.
Down the leg side, Mendis looks to sweep but misses.
Short and served wider outside off, Chandimal pushes it towards covers and calls for a quick single.
Fuller around middle and off, Chandimal blocks it out.
Fuller on the stumps, bunted back to the bowler.
Drinks are on the field...
Drops it short on off, punched off the back foot towards the cover fielder.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Pushes it quicker through the air, defended into the ground.
Floats it up around off, defended into the ground.
Short again, cut towards the point fielder.
Short and around off, defended from within the crease.
Yasir Shah is back on!
Darts it around the pads, Chandimal flicks it straight to backward square leg. A successful over for Sohail.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Shorter one on the stumps, punched towards mid on.
Floats it up outside off, Chandimal lunges forward to defend but the ball takes the outer part of the bat and rolls towards backward point.
Skipper, Dinesh Chandimal walks in next with his side in real trouble. Can he play another big innings to bail his side out of this?

OUT! Haris Sohail strikes! Did his job with the bat earlier and now he is making the ball talk! Pakistan are turning it on here. He keeps it full on middle, Silva gets down to play the sweep shot. It's too full to play that kind of shot. The ball straightens a touch and pings him on the pads right in front of the stumps. Umpire Kettleborough has no harm in raising his dreaded finger to the appeal that has been made. Kaushal doesn't opt for a review as he knew he was a dead duck. Sri Lanka lead by 48 runs!
Slider around middle, Silva goes back and defends.
Quicker in line of the stumps, kept out watchfully.
Stays back to the flatter delivery and blocks it.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Mid-wicket and mid on go back.

FOUR! Intent from Mendis! Floated outside off, the young man skips down the track and drives it uppishly past mid on for a boundary. Didn't get it off the meat of the beat but gets the desired result. Perhaps, that's the way to play a part-time spinner. Can't let Shafiq settle down.
Leg bye! On middle and leg, Silva looks to turn it across but the ball brushes his pads and rolls towards fine leg. A leg bye taken.
Tossed up outside off, Silva defends it tentatively off the inner half of his bat.
Good news for Pakistan! Hasan Ali is back on the field.
Mendis leans ahead and blocks it out watchfully.
Flatter and way outside off, left alone.
The batsman dances down the track but decides to defend it.

Chance of a run out! Kaushal Silva would have been sent packing here! Flighted delivery outside off, Silva comes forward and drives it towards cover before taking off. There is a slight hesitation between the two as they see Wahab Riaz (sub) attacking the ball but eventually go for the run. The fielder picks up the ball and throws it at the non-striker's end. Sohail, the bowler doesn't come behind the stumps to collect and the ball goes further. No one backing up either and it's four bonus runs to Sri Lanka. Had Sohail collected it, Silva would have been a goner as he wasn't even in the frame.
Gets forward and pushes it towards point.
Starts off with a loopy ball on middle, flicked towards mid-wicket.
Haris Sohail is brought into the attack now.
Goes around the wicket and drops it around middle, turning down leg as Mendis misses his flick shot.
Flatter one in line of the stumps, defended back to Asad.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.
On middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for one.
That kept low! Bowls an off spinner around off, Mendis rocks back to punch it through the line but this one stays really low and the batsman has to crouch to keep that one out. Alarming signs these!
Floats it up outside off, spins back in as Mendis works it straight to square leg.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Once again drifts it in on middle and leg, Kaushal Silva looks to flick but gets a leading edge which rolls safely towards cover.
Bowls a googly with doesn't spin. The flipper which is called. Silva plants his front foot across and leaves it alone.
Drifting in on middle, Kusal Mendis looks to work it away on the leg side but gets a leading edge towards cover.
Short on off, turning further away. As long as it is short, no trouble for the batsman. Mendis goes back and cuts it towards the cover-point fielder.
Quicker one outside off, defended towards cover-point.
Dances down the track and wrists it towards mid on.
Tossed it up on off, Kaushal brings his bat close to the pad to defend it. Ahmed likes it and appreciates!
Quicker through the air outside off, punched towards cover.
Sensible! Allows the ball to pitch and then works it with the spin towards mid-wicket.
Flatter on middle, tucked through square leg for a single.
Risky! Floats it up outside off, Mendis looks to play against the spin and almost falls in the trap. The ball catches the inner half of the bat and dies down in front of the mid-wicket fielder.
Pitch it up Yasir! He once again bowls it on a shorter length, Silva punches it in the same region to collect another couple.
Short and outside off, Kaushal Silva goes back and forces it square of the wicket on the off side for a couple.
Tosses it up on off, nicely dealt by KS.
It's spinning too much now! Yasir Shah lands it on middle, it turns square. Sarfraz almost collects it near first slip. Kaushal Silva admires this.
Silva presses forward and stonewalls this loopy ball.
Drops it short outside off, punched off the back foot towards cover.
Quicker one around middle and off, worked towards mid on.
Kusal Mendis strides out to bat.

OUT! Asad Shafiq strikes! Would you believe it? I couldn't honestly! He has been asked to complete Hasan Ali's over and look what he's done! Asad pushes it nicely outside off, Thirimanne lunges forward to defend but it turns away with some extra bounce and catches the feather of the bat. Sarfraz Ahmed behind the stumps takes the catch. He appeals but Asad Shafiq is not even bothered to look back at the umpire, he knows he has got his man. Second Test wicket for him and what a time to do so. Sri Lanka in a spot of bother now.
Flattish on middle, tucked towards mid-wicket.
Shafiq dops it on a shorter length around off, defended off the back foot.

Hasan Ali is walking off! He has been really bending his back in this spell. He is feeling uncomfortable and is going off the field due to a sore back. Wahab Riaz is the substitute fielder. Meanwhile, Asad Shafiq will complete the over.
Once again hits the deck hard, Lahiru moves inside the line to keep Sarfraz busy.
Bangs in a short ball outside off, Thirimanne arches his back to let that one go through to the keeper.
Flatter one on off, cut away towards the point fielder.
Drifting in on middle, tucked on the bounce towards the short leg fielder.
Floats it up around middle and off, Kaushal keeps his bat close to the pad and defends.
Gives it a nice flight and lands it around off, Silva comes down the track and drives it towards the cover fielder.
Drops it a bit short outside off, punched off the back foot towards cover for a single.
Outside off, turning back in, worked with the spin past short leg.
Switches the angle, goes around the wicket and hits the deck hard around leg. Gets a good amount of bounce as the batsman ducks under it.
Keeps it on a fuller length on middle and off, jammed out well by Silva.
Bangs in a short ball outside off, Kaushal Silva ducks under it.
Angles in a full length delivery on the pads, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Length delivery on off, defended with a straight blade.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Thirimanne dabs it with an angled bat towards point.
Gets behind the line and keeps it out watchfully.
That was a good ball! Flatter one around off, draws Silva forward to defend. He obliges but it straightens to beat the outside edge.
Quicker through the air, landing full on off, Kaushal comes forward to defend but gets it off the outer half of the bat towards short third man.
Flighted delivery outside off, defended by lunging forward for a single.
Loops it up on the stumps, wristed through mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter through the air outside off, Kaushal doesn't play at it.
Bouncer again, Lahiru ducks under it comfortably this time.
That was a brute of a delivery! Ali steams in from around the wicket and hits the deck hard, generating substantial bounce. Thirimanne gets into a tangle but somehow manages to duck under it.
Similar length delivery outside off, Silva punches it firmly through cover-point to rotate strike.
Back of a length on off, Kaushal defends it stoutly.
Fuller in length outside off, skids through the surface. Silva comes forward confidently to keep it out.
Length delivery outside off, shaping in. Silva points his bat skywards to allow it through.
Time for Drinks.
Flighted delivery, defended solidly off the front foot. End of a testing over from Yasir Shah.

Nervy moment! A very, very loose stroke! Tossed up outside off and gets it to pitch in the rough. Thirimanne goes for an expansive drive against the spin but is completely bamboozled. Wonder how that didn't knock the off stump over!

A loud shout for a caught behind denied! Around off, turning down the leg side. Lahiru looks to help it away but misses. Shah is confident but the umpire stays put. Replays show that there was no wood involved and it came off the pad.

Tight run! Silva uses his feet and wrists it to Azhar Ali at mid on. Calls for the single immediately and his partner responds. The shy at the bowler's end misses. Had he hit, it would have been close.
Stays back to the shortish delivery and keeps it out.
The pitch is playing tricks! Pitches on middle and turns away sharply to go past the outside edge of Silva's bat.
FOUR! Sublime! Half-volley outside off, Thirimanne leans ahead and drives it elegantly through covers to find the fence. First boundary of the innings.
Full length ball outside off, Thirimanne lunges forward in defense.
Length delivery around off, Lahiru covers the line and defends it stoutly.
Short delivery, pulled through backward square leg to rotate strike.
Back of a length outside off, pushed firmly off the back foot to covers.
Angling in from outside off, Silva defends it with a straight bat.
Going down leg, Silva helps it through backward square leg for a run.
Fullish on middle and leg, Kaushal lunges forward in defense.
Fires it outside off, Silva doesn't fiddle with it.
Quicker and flatter outside off, stays low. Kaushal leaves it alone.
Short delivery outside off, cut to point.
Quicker through the air around off, defended solidly off the front foot.
Good length delivery on middle and off, LT leans forward and blocks.
Fuller on middle and leg, clipped towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Touch shorter this time on off, Lahiru lifts his bat and lets it be.
Slants it away on a fuller length on off, Thirimanne shoulders his arms to it.
Fuller and angling in on the pads, glanced down to fine leg for a single.
Starts off from around the wicket and lands it on a length on off, Silva stabs it off the back foot towards point.
Hasan Ali to bowl now.
Things are already happening! Turns in sharply from the rough outside off, Thirimanne looks to block it but gets hit on the thigh pad. Terrific first over from Shah.
Tossed up around off, defended off the front foot.
Lahiru Thirimanne is the new man in.

OUT! Shah strikes in his very first over! He has already started weaving his magic. From around the wicket, he tosses it up nicely outside off in the rough. Gets it to spin in with some extra bounce. Karunaratne looks to work it across but gets an inside edge onto his pads. The ball lobs behind Shan Masood at short leg. He backpedals and dives forward to take a really good catch. The stubborn opening stand comes to an end. Wait on! The replays roll in and surprise, surprise. The Snicko shows that there was a clear daylight between bat and ball. The spike was due to the bat hitting the ground. Strange that the southpaw didn't realize it. Reviews are meant for these kind of circumstances. Nevertheless, Pakistan rejoice!
Shortish outside off, Silva places it to backward point for a brisk single.
Outside off, cut with the spin to point.
Fullish delivery on off, clipped through mid-wicket for a run.
Time for spin. Yasir Shah comes into the attack. Can he weave his magic?
Fullish delivery outside off, keeps low. Silva points his bat skywards to allow it through.

Good running! Fuller length ball on off, Dimuth clips it with good timing through mid-wicket. Yasir Shah in the deep has a lot of ground to cover to his right. The two batsmen sense the opportunity and take three.
Full delivery outside off, Dimuth leans ahead to block it.
Angling into the hips, turned through square leg for a single.
Fullish delivery attacking the stumps, blocked watchfully.
Fractionally overpitched outside off, knocked to short cover where the fielder dives to his right to stop it.
Karunaratne is getting his bat taped.
Back of a length on the ribs, Kaushal hops and tucks it around the corner for a run.
Lapse in concentration! Short delivery well outside off, Silva shuffles and aims to play a pull shot across the line but misses it completely. That took off after landing.
Slower delivery on a fullish length outside off. Kaushal plays it with soft hands to covers.
Short delivery on middle, Silva pulls it through backward square leg. Amir from fine leg runs across and saves a couple for his side.
On a length on off, defended solidly off the back foot.
Fullish delivery around off, Silva leans ahead and taps it to covers.
That was close! Similar length delivery outside off, swinging in substantially. Karunaratne knows where his off stump is and makes a brave leave. That was not far from the off pole.
Stays back to the good length delivery and punches it to point.
Straying on the pads, tucked around the corner for another couple.
Swinging in sharply on a fuller length. Karunaratne clips it through mid-wicket for a brace.
Fullish delivery on off, kept out watchfully.
Overpitched outside off, played with an angled bat face to point.
Fuller in length around off, Silva covers the line and blocks it. Maiden for Abbas.
That almost took the outside edge! Good length delivery in the zone of apprehension, a bit of nibble there. Silva goes for a drive with minimal foot movement and gets beaten comprehensively.
Sliva has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Abbas hits the deck hard this time and gets Silva to duck under it. Kaushal is standing way in front of the crease to negotiate the swing.
Back of a length on off, defended solidly off the back foot.
Full length delivery attacking the stumps, Silva pushes it to mid on.
Good length delivery around off, Karunaratne offers a straight bat in defense.
Fullish delivery swerving into Kaushal. He clips it to square leg for a run. He took his bottom hand off while playing it.
Short delivery, going down leg. Silva ducks underneath it.
Full length delivery, angling in from outside off. Kaushal puts his head down and defends it with a high elbow.
Short of a length outside off, stabbed to point.
Straight on this occasion, flicked to forward short leg.
In the corridor of uncertainty, Dimuth leans ahead to defend it.
Shortish outside off and width on offer. Silva cuts it nicely but Shah at point dives to his right to save certain runs. Keeps it down to a single.
On a length again, shaping in. Kaushal clips it to short leg.
Length delivery outside off, pushed off the front foot to covers.
Fuller in length this time, a hint of inswing there. Silva prods forward tentatively to keep it out.
Length delivery on off, jags back prodigiously. Silva is taken aback a bit but manages to fend it off to short leg.
Fullish delivery around off, swinging in appreciably. Karunaratne is hurried in his front foot defence and gets a thick outside edge past mid-wicket. Two runs taken.
Angling into the hips, tucked through backward square leg for a run.
On a similar length outside off, punched firmly off the back foot to point.
Length delivery outside off, stays low. Silva is undone by it and gets beaten.
Back of a length outside off, shaping away this time. Kaushal doesn't fiddle with it.

Brilliant bowling! Hits the deck hard from around the wicket and gets it to swing in sharply. Silva's feet go nowhere. He looks to place it square of the wicket on the off side but gets beaten on the inside edge.

That's a peach! Back of a length on off, hits the deck and seams away appreciably with extra bounce. Karunaratne has no option but to play at it and is beaten all ends up. A brilliant start from Abbas.
Back of a length on off, Dimuth defends it stoutly.
Shorter in length outside off, shoots off after pitching. Karunaratne leaves it alone.
Length delivery on off, shaping away after pitching. Dimuth points his bat skywards to let it go.
Fullish delivery around off, Sliva shuffles across and tucks it through mid-wicket for a run. He is off the mark with that.
Back of a length delivery, slapped to backward point.
No ball! Fullish delivery outside off, shaping in. Silva plants his front foot across and watches it through. Abbas has overstepped on this occasion. He fails to take a hat-trick.
Mohammad Abbas to share the new ball from the other end. He is on a hat-trick. Can he take it? Three slips and a gully are waiting.
Full delivery in line of the stump, eased to mid on.
On a good length outside off, bowled with a scrambled seam and generates some extra bounce. Karunaratne watches it closely and makes a good leave.
Angling into the southpaw sharply. He offers a straight bat in defense.
On a fullish length outside off, this time it swings away. Dimuth doesn't flirt with it.
Fullish delivery, swinging in. Karunaratne tucks it to mid-wicket.
Length delivery outside off, Karunaratne lunges forward and pushes it to covers.
